SCANFI data

Source: R/SCANFI.R
scanfi.Rd

Get and prepare SCANFI v2 (Spatialized Canadian National Forest Inventory) data as a SpatRaster. SCANFI provides wall-to-wall 30 m maps of forest structure, composition, biomass, and age for Canada (Guindon et al. 2026; doi:10.23687/07653869-f303-46c2-a04e-9ab479b73cbf ).

Usage

scanfi(
  type = "all",
  years = 2020L,
  flavour = c("public", "private"),
  dest_dir = NULL,
  study_area = NULL,
  drive_folder = "1i7w4tO52Sh45tRwlUiUEnwidOeE5Zq68"
)

Arguments

type

character vector of layer types to fetch (see Details).

years

integer year(s) to fetch (v2 spans 1985-2025 in 5-year steps).

flavour

one of "public" (default) or "private" (see Details).

dest_dir

character, destination directory for downloads (defaults to a subdirectory of tempdir()).

study_area

(optional) SpatVector (or sf) to which the rasters are cropped and masked.

drive_folder

Google Drive folder id for the "private" flavour.

Value

SpatRaster (one layer per downloaded SCANFI file).

Details

type selects which layers to fetch; it accepts the group aliases "all" (default), "structure", and "species", and/or any of the specific tokens below. National data are large, so only the requested layers are downloaded (public flavour) and rasters are read lazily – when study_area is supplied, only that window is read from disk.

Structural attributes and age (one layer per requested years):

  • biomass: aboveground biomass (t/ha);

  • closure: total crown closure (%);

  • height: forest height (m);

  • landcover: NFI-compatible land cover classification;

  • age: forest stand age (years).

Tree-species crown closure (%; "species" selects all):

  • balsamFir, blackSpruce, broadleaf, douglasFir, jackPine, lodgepolePine, otherConiferous, ponderosaPine, tamarack, whiteRedPine.

Other:

  • mask: northern-extrapolation mask (year-agnostic integer mask).

Two flavours are available:

  • "public": the NRCan public v2 product (https://ftp.maps.canada.ca/pub/nrcan_rncan/Forests_Foret/SCANFI/v2), holding the full 1985-2025 time series (5-year steps);

  • "private": a periodically-updated Google Drive dataset (2000, 2010, 2020), which requires the googledrive package and Drive authentication.
